## MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the Current Market Regime?**
CAUTION regime — low volatility (Vol: 18.0%) but very narrow participation with breadth 0/8 sectors positive.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Holding & Investment is least weak with DOHOL (1W: +3.21% | 1M: +0.28%) ABOVE TREND, Banking shows short-term catch-up via GARAN (1W: +2.58% | 1M: -7.95%) RECOVERY, Energy has pockets of strength led by TRMET (1W: +13.05% | 1M: +17.69%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology & Telecom is the clear laggard with KONTR (1W: -19.05% | 1M: +20.40%) CORRECTION and TTKOM (1W: -11.18% | 1M: -16.39%) BELOW TREND; Construction and Heavy Industry also under pressure with TOASO (1W: -11.92% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
TRMET (1W: +13.05% | 1M: +17.69%) ABOVE TREND, EREGL (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +4.13%) ABOVE TREND, TKFEN (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +6.42%) ABOVE TREND, DOHOL (1W: +3.21% | 1M: +0.28%) ABOVE TREND, GARAN (1W: +2.58% | 1M: -7.95%) RECOVERY.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
PETKM (1W: -4.97% | 1M: +3.47%) CORRECTION, TUPRS (1W: -5.17% | 1M: +33.90%) CORRECTION, ALARK (1W: -5.57% | 1M: -1.62%) BELOW TREND, TRALT (1W: -6.22% | 1M: -1.06%) BELOW TREND, ULKER (1W: -6.51% | 1M: -12.35%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Upside momentum: TRMET (1W: +13.05% | 1M: +17.69%) ABOVE TREND, EREGL (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +4.13%) ABOVE TREND, TKFEN (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +6.42%) ABOVE TREND; downside momentum: KONTR (1W: -19.05% | 1M: +20.40%) CORRECTION, TOASO (1W: -11.92% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND, TTKOM (1W: -11.18% | 1M: -16.39%) BELOW TREND.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Banking Sector Outlook?**
Defensive tone; AKBNK (1W: -1.35% | 1M: -14.82%) BELOW TREND, GARAN (1W: +2.58% | 1M: -7.95%) RECOVERY, ISCTR (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -13.03%) BELOW TREND — selective trading rather than fresh longs.

**8. Industrial Sector Outlook?**
Mixed: EREGL (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +4.13%) ABOVE TREND is a relative leader while FROTO (1W: -4.38% | 1M: -10.09%) BELOW TREND and TOASO (1W: -11.92% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND show ongoing weakness.

**9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?**
Divergent: TRMET (1W: +13.05% | 1M: +17.69%) ABOVE TREND and SASA (1W: +1.59% | 1M: +1.19%) ABOVE TREND versus TUPRS (1W: -5.17% | 1M: +33.90%) CORRECTION and PETKM (1W: -4.97% | 1M: +3.47%) CORRECTION — trade selectively around catalysts.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Under CAUTION, trim broad beta and favor high-conviction, ABOVE TREND names (TRMET, EREGL, TKFEN) while keeping hedges or cash; avoid adding exposure to clear BELOW TREND/technology laggards.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
TRMET (1W: +13.05% | 1M: +17.69%) ABOVE TREND for continuation or profit-taking, TUPRS (1W: -5.17% | 1M: +33.90%) CORRECTION on oil moves, KONTR (1W: -19.05% | 1M: +20.40%) CORRECTION for volatility-driven reversals, EREGL (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +4.13%) ABOVE TREND for industrial demand signals, GARAN (1W: +2.58% | 1M: -7.95%) RECOVERY for banking flows.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
Energy & Chemicals for commodity-driven swings, Technology & Telecom for risk-off cascades and earnings/sector news, Banking for continued selective recovery plays.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch XU100 reaction to this week’s low/high — failure to reclaim the weekly high confirms squeeze risk; upside requires re-assertion of sector breadth or positive TL/FX flows, downside catalysts include global risk-off, weaker-than-expected corporate guidance, or renewed tech sell-off.

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Low volatility but zero-sector breadth puts the market in CAUTION — narrow rallies in names like TRMET and EREGL are not broad-based. Stay selective: favor ABOVE TREND stocks for tactical longs, hedge or reduce exposure to technology and deep BELOW TREND names.
